name: 行锁级联: blocker idle in tx
cause: lock_waits > 3 — 可能有 DDL 锁
findings: 可能有 ALTER TABLE / CREATE INDEX 等 DDL 操作持有 AccessExclusiveLock 阻塞查询
actions: [排查] 查看 AccessExclusive 锁持有者 | SQL: SELECT l.pid, a.usename, l.relation::regclass, l.mode, a.state, LEFT(a.query, 80) FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.mode = 'AccessExclusiveLock' AND l.granted
[修复] 使用 CONCURRENTLY 选项避免阻塞 | SQL: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_name ON table_name (column);

name: full_page_writes IO放大
cause: lock_waits > 3 — 可能有 DDL 锁
findings: 可能有 ALTER TABLE / CREATE INDEX 等 DDL 操作持有 AccessExclusiveLock 阻塞查询
actions: [排查] 查看 AccessExclusive 锁持有者 | SQL: SELECT l.pid, a.usename, l.relation::regclass, l.mode, a.state, LEFT(a.query, 80) FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.mode = 'AccessExclusiveLock' AND l.granted
[修复] 使用 CONCURRENTLY 选项避免阻塞 | SQL: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_name ON table_name (column);

findings: 超过 20 个会话处于 idle in transaction，事务未提交严重

actions: [紧急] 查找并终止最老的 idle in transaction | SQL: SELECT pid, usename, state, xact_start, now()-xact_start AS idle_duration, LEFT(query, 80) AS last_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' ORDER BY xact_start LIMIT 10
[修复] 设置 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout | SQL: ALTER SYSTEM SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '5min'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
